# Poof!

> Lightweight self-hosted deployment daemon: git push → deployed container
> (or static site) behind Caddy with automatic TLS, on your own server.

## Docs

- [Agent reference](https://poof.rac.so/AGENTS.md): CLI surface, core workflow, incident-response commands
- [Full README](https://github.com/racso/poof#readme): complete documentation
- [Install script](https://poof.rac.so/install): `curl -fsSL https://poof.rac.so/install | sh -s server|client`
